Show prints an entity (an id, an old id, or a path; default ".", where you
are): its id, kind and freshness, its absolute path, a breadcrumb up to
the root with each ancestor's title and summary, its summary, its labels,
a file's symbols and sections, its children by importance, and its edges
by kind (depends on, used by, documented by, documents, tests, tested by,
changes with). A path is canonicalized: one that leads out of every
indexed project (a symlink, say) is refused.

Usage:
  agent index show [ID|PATH] [flags]

Examples:
  agent index show .
  agent index show alpha:src/lib.rs
  agent index show src/lib.rs --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for show
      --json   Print the entity and its neighborhood as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
